ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
benefits_summary: Monthly financial assistance of ₹2,000 transferred directly via DBT to the woman head of the family listed on the household Ration Card.
exclusions: Families where the woman head or her husband is an Income Tax or GST payer
documents_required: Antyodaya, BPL, or APL Ration Card showing woman as family head
Identity Proof of Woman Head and Spouse
application_steps: Apply on the Karnataka Seva Sindhu Guarantee Schemes Portal or visit a Bangalore One / Karnataka One / Bapuji Seva Kendra center.
Provide Ration Card number and verify family details.
Receive ₹2,000 monthly directly into your bank account.
